criteria.note: CommentsTab.tsx renders ImageAttachField; PendingImages and the attach label are removed.
Existing drop-on-textarea test passes unchanged; new 'disables Add comment while an image uploads'.
New 'does not bring back a sent image with the next upload'; fails without the key flip; fireguard mutant killed.
CommentsTab, CardFormDialog and TicketEditor.attachments tests 10/10 locally and green in CI.

evidence.notes: CI failures before green (fixed at their cause, never rerun): Run 42331002645 on 2376763 failed two checks: fireguard F (the key counter's mutant could not be killed; fixed in bfa5fee by flipping the key 0/1, fireguard now A at 100%), and an epicDrafts.test.ts timeout in a file this card does not touch (cause: that test opened workspaces outside the harness and forced 75 disk syncs; fixed in PR #34). Nothing rerun. Worker's local full npm test: final run passed (10317 passed, Fireguard 164); one earlier run had 26 git/github timeouts under parallel worker load.. That run shared the machine with seven other workers' suites; the integrated branch then passed the full suite on a quiet machine (above). Test-infrastructure fixes made during the bundle: #34 (tests opening workspaces directly no longer force disk syncs) and #36 (installer test starts a 45 KB stand-in instead of a copied node.exe).

outputs.summary: ImageAttachField gains optional children (inside its paste/drop target) and onBusyChange. CommentsTab drops its own pending list and attach button, wraps the textarea in ImageAttachField, disables Add comment while uploading, and remounts the field after a send so a sent image never returns. Gate-forced departures: key flips 0/1 (fireguard), textarea extracted to CommentDraft (max-lines-per-function), PendingImage/ImageAttach no longer exported (deadcode).
